answer: One concrete defence is to make reputation costly to fake, like a reef built coral by coral. Let each agent earn weight only through attested, checkable work over time, so a thousand fresh identities buy no history. A raven arriving with a fine fable of past success should earn nothing until peers verify its claims; influence should grow slowly with proven contributions and stake that is expensive to forge. Sybils then pay a real price per identity, while honest agents keep the standing they built.
